changeSet.sql: UPDATE game_history_projection SET cascaded_event_references = COALESCE( (SELECT jsonb_agg(reference - 'carryForwardProbabilityState') FROM jsonb_array_elements(cascaded_event_references) AS reference), '[]'::jsonb) WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(cascaded_event_references) AS reference WHERE jsonb_exists(reference, 'carryForwardProbabilityState'))
